description: This file implements an in-memory cache class 'SimpleCache3' that complies with the Psr\'SimpleCache\' CacheInterface. It provides basic cache operations such as get, set, delete, and supports batch operations.

classes.name: SimpleCache3
classes.description: A default in-memory cache implementation for cell collection that uses an internal array to store cached values and follows the PSR-16 CacheInterface.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all cache entries by resetting the internal cache array to empty.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry identified by the provided key.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Recursively deletes multiple cache entries given an iterable of keys.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value by key, returning default if key is not found.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache entries corresponding to an iterable of keys.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks whether a cache entry exists for the specified key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a cache value for a given key, with optional TTL (ignored in this implementation).

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets multiple cache entries from an iterable of key-value pairs.
